output.reason: The computed artifact diff between the v0.37.8 CRD [ev-8998581760b8] and the v1.0.0 CRD [ev-451bd6a12e72] shows the storage version of ec2nodeclasses.karpenter.k8s.aws moving from v1beta1 to v1. It also says existing objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten and status.storedVersions is updated. Clusters are exposed when that CRD's status.storedVersions still lists v1beta1. That is exactly the canonical stored-version migration condition the proposal uses. The narrower gvk-in-use and edge-from-version alternatives would miss exposed clusters or flag clusters that are not exposed.
